## Goal
Implement the requested change from the agent mention.

## Original request
> Yes. In PR #197, inline comment minimization was removed for **prompt-managed inline review comments**. It was not removed globally: generated top-level review/rubrics/fix-pr/handoff cleanup is still controlled by `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS` in the docs.
> 
> Why it happened: #196 asked whether same-agent inline cleanup should use GitHub “resolved” instead of “minimized.” This PR implemented that as a replacement: reviewer suggestions changed from `mark_existing_outdated` to `resolve_existing_thread`, and synthesis now says `do not delete or minimize inline comments`.
> 
> Dual mode is reasonable. I’d implement it as a follow-up, not by overloading `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS`, because that variable currently means generated comment cleanup, while inline thread cleanup is documented as separate.
> 
> Proposed plan:
> 
> 1. Add an inline-specific mode, e.g. `AGENT_INLINE_COMMENT_CLEANUP_MODE=resolve|minimize|off`.
> 2. Keep `resolve` as the default for addressed/superseded same-agent review threads.
> 3. Restore the old `minimizeComment(... OUTDATED)` path only when mode is `minimize`.
> 4. Keep strict guards for both modes: same PR, same agent, no humans/other bots, re-fetch before mutation.
> 5. Update `.github/prompts/review.md`, `.github/prompts/review-synthesize.md`, docs, and prompt-contract tests.
> 6. Preserve `do not delete inline comments` always.
> 
> That gives us the current safer default while still supporting repos that prefer the old minimized/outdated UX.

@sepo-agent /implement

## Acceptance criteria
- Implement the requested change.
- Preserve existing behavior unless the request requires a change.
- Update tests or validation as needed.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/197
